messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 2334 — High 5xx spike observed on /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Paging samir (oncall). Severity: P1.

samir: Ack. Oncall here. Looking at logs now. Any recent deploys or config pushes?

marta: seeing sustained 5xx ~18% over last 60s on gen-mesh-eu. Error surface: KV cache miss -> kernel fallback errors. There was a routing config push ~25m ago (router 0fde3).

leo: we have a warm backup cluster (gen-backup-eu). Can start failover routing at LB level if we want to reduce customer impact quickly.

samir: Plan: 1) Activate failover to gen-backup for eu-west-1 2) Rollback routing change if safe 3) Publish initial statuspage update + customer note 4) Re-evaluate in 30m. Assigning tasks: marta -> root cause + metrics; leo -> failover; amanda -> status copy.

amanda: will draft statuspage copy. Need exact impact wording and ETA for next update.

marta: no evidence of data loss. Affected: streaming and sync/generate endpoints in eu-west-1 only. Approx 18% of requests in that region fail with 5xx. Errors concentrated in long-tail generation requests.

samir: initiating failover: `./infractl route apply --policy failover-gen --region eu-west-1 --dry-run=false`

devdeploy-bot: route-change job started by samir — job id 87421. CI log: http://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/87421

marta: traffic shifting now. New requests hitting gen-backup-eu. Observed error rate drop on newly routed clients to ~3%. Old sessions may continue to see errors until reconnect.

amanda: DRAFT statuspage copy (please review & suggest customer-facing wording):

```
Component: Generation API — eu-west-1
Impact: Partial service degradation. Approximately 18% of generation requests in the eu-west-1 region are returning 5xx errors; streaming sessions may be degraded.
Detected: 2024-06-22T14:30Z UTC
Current status: We are routing new requests to a backup cluster to mitigate errors while we investigate the root cause. No customer data loss has been detected.
Next update: We will provide updates every 30 minutes or sooner as the situation evolves.
```

samir: tweak: remove internal terms (kernel, KV) from public copy. Add expected next update time: 14:58Z. Also add simple mitigation line: "We have implemented routing to a backup cluster to restore service availability."

amanda: updated. New draft ready.

samir: publishing command (ops): `statusctl publish --component generation-eu --body-file /tmp/status-2334.md --visibility public` — someone to run and confirm?

leo: I'll run publish and monitor health dashboards.

devdeploy-bot: statusctl publish job started by leo — job id 55678

devdeploy-bot: statusctl publish job succeeded — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2334 (public)

amanda: Published. Sharing link in #customers-updates and sending short notice to impacted customers list.

marta: Suggest next technical step: keep failover active for at least 30m, then can canary traffic back if error rate for 5m < 1%. Will collect traces for RCA.

samir: agreed. Schedule: updates every 30m, next at 14:58Z. If stable by then, we attempt canary. If not, keep failover and escalate to eng-runtime.

incident-bot: Reminder: If incident extends beyond 2h, create a formal handoff and use /incident-handoff to update on-call rota.

amanda: Preparing customer email template for impacted customers; will attach statuspage link and brief summary.

leo: Observability green: error rate for eu-west-1 now ~2.8% overall, request latency normalizing. No downstream systems impacted.

samir: Draft resolved notice for review (will publish if metrics stable for 10m):

```
Resolved — 2024-06-22T15:05Z UTC
Summary: A service disruption in eu-west-1 caused by an internal runtime routing issue resulted in elevated 5xx errors for a subset of generation requests. We mitigated the impact by routing traffic to a backup cluster and rolling back the routing change. All services have returned to normal levels and we have found no evidence of customer data loss.
Next steps: Engineering will continue an RCA; a follow-up postmortem will be shared with affected customers and internally.
```

amanda: LGTM. I'll queue the resolved publish once marta confirms stability.

marta: metrics stable for 12m. :thumbsup: Proceed to resolved publish when ready.

samir: Publishing resolved now. `statusctl publish --incident 2334 --state resolved`

devdeploy-bot: statusctl publish (resolved) succeeded — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2334/resolve

amanda: Sending customer emails and internal summary. Will prep post-incident comms and RCA doc.

samir: Thanks team. Handoff to marta and amanda for RCA and customer follow-ups. I'll remain available if anything regresses.

leo: good work all. :raised_hands:
